name: std::ranges::drop_view<V>::end

declarations.code:
constexpr auto end() const
    requires ranges::range<const V>;

intro:
Returns a sentinel or an iterator representing the end of the drop_view.

Effectively returns ranges::end(base_), where base_ is the underlying view.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A sentinel or an iterator representing the end of the view.

summary: Returns a sentinel or an iterator representing the end of the drop_view.
